openaiApiKey.label: Developer OpenAI API Key (sk-…)
openaiApiKey.helpText: Devvit constraint: secrets must be global. This key is shared across all subreddit installs of vibe-mod (per-install BYOK override available via subredditOpenaiApiKey below). Daily quota per sub is enforced to bound cost. Set it after the first upload: `npx devvit settings set openaiApiKey`.

openaiModel.label: OpenAI model for rule compilation (reasoning_effort: none, verbosity: low)

options.label: gpt-5.4-mini (recommended — fastest ~1.1s, 7/7 on the rule-compile smoke test)
gpt-5.4 (full — slower ~1.8s, more cautious about ambiguous rules; no quality gain for this task)

subredditOpenaiApiKey.label: Override: this subreddit's own OpenAI key (optional)
subredditOpenaiApiKey.helpText: Leave blank to use vibe-mod's shared key (subject to daily quota). Paste your own sk-… key to bypass the quota and bill your own OpenAI account. Note: Devvit cannot encrypt subreddit-scope settings; this value will be visible to mods of this sub. Treat the key accordingly.

dryRunOnly.label: Dry-run mode (rules log what they would do, but never act)

maxActionsPerHour.label: Auto-pause if more than N actions per hour (safety brake)

shadowDurationHours.label: Shadow-mode duration before a new rule can go live (hours)
